_about: Level 2 eval (scripts/eval.py --l2 / --l2-only): scripted chats sent to frontline.chat one user turn at a time (stops after a handoff), fresh session id each run, Adapty writes disabled (a grant the code allows is counted as 'allowed', i.e. would grant). Scored on what the code did: `grant` = 'allowed' (some grant_access call allowed) | 'blocked:<policy reason>' (only blocked calls; first reason) | 'none' (no grant_access call); `handoff` = the handoff reason, null = no handoff, 'any' = not scored. A list means any of these values. `steps_forbid` / `steps_require`: 'kind:store' of store_instructions calls that must not / must have run. `reply`: checks on what the agent wrote, judged by the model over the transcript, the tool results and the raw profile (skip with --no-judge). Every run also checks the log: a call that was not allowed must carry a blocked_reason. `setup.prior_grant` writes a grant row into the scratch DB before the chat; `setup.profile` replaces the cached profile (a live snapshot). Clock: `as_of` (top level, or per scenario) is 'now' for the agent and the limits, so expiry dates in the cached profiles keep their meaning. Profiles = cached in data/demo.sqlite on Sat 7 Nov unless setup.profile; config = models.AgentConfig() defaults (max_days 7, 1 grant per 30 days, require_paid). `origin`: 'live-1108-NN' = a real chat on the live model on 8 Nov (same user text), 'new' = written for this set, 'v2' = the first set.
